example:
import { EditorialAuthCard } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialAuthCard title="Welcome back." description="Sign in to see your collection." footer="New here?" />
name: EditorialAuthCard

props.description: Heading level. Default: 2. `1` makes the card title the page h1 (pair with `<EditorialAuth level={2}>`).
props.name: level

props.description: "lg" scopes `--control-height` inside the card to --editorial-auth-card-control-height-lg (48px), so every Input / Button / Select in the form takes the sign-in density.
props.name: controlSize

tagline: The form card of EditorialAuth (gh#1439): badge, title, copy, the form (`children`) and a ruled footer line ("New to the site? Create an account").
usage: DO keep one form per card.
